presets.label: Shopping
presets.visitor_intent: Compare two objects, choose a finish, and review quantities and costs.
main_path: list: compare two products
product: choose a finish; Add to cart
cart: quantity 1–5, remove/undo
review: inspect amounts; Finish local review

presets.inappropriate_when: A large marketplace needs search, stock and fulfillment rules. This small catalog does not represent checkout.

routes.cancel: Removal has Undo last removal; no purchase cancellation exists.
routes.exit: Choose another example; cart and finish selections remain in memory.
routes.browser_back: Restores prior stage with the current cart. A stale review route with an empty cart becomes cart.

states.error: Adding beyond 5 per finish announces the limit; current cart retained.
states.recovery: Undo last removal once; repeated undo does not add another item.

articles.title: Store seeds between seasons
articles.summary: Dry containers, labels, and a cool shelf.

sections.title: Before storing
sections.body: Let the seed packet and container dry. A small paper envelope keeps each variety separate. Label it with the plant name and collection date.

sections.title: On the shelf
sections.body: Keep the envelopes in a closed, dry container away from sunlight. These are synthetic garden notes; storage needs vary by seed type.

articles.title: Clean hand tools after use
articles.summary: Remove soil and dry tools before putting them away.

sections.title: Remove soil
sections.body: Brush off loose soil. Wipe the handle and blade, then leave both to dry.

sections.title: Store separately
sections.body: Keep sharp tools in a covered tray. This is a fictional handbook entry, not equipment safety advice.

articles.title: Label a shared storage shelf
articles.summary: Use names that describe the items in each space.

sections.title: Group the items
sections.body: Keep items used together in one place. Give each shelf a short name based on its contents.

sections.title: Keep labels useful
sections.body: Update the label when the contents change. These local examples contain no account or shared service.

lessons.title: Read the axes
lessons.body: An axis label tells you what a number measures. Read the label and unit before comparing values.
lessons.question: The vertical axis is labeled ‘Minutes’. What does a value of 12 mean?

lessons.title: Compare two values
lessons.body: Compare values that share the same unit. A value of 18 minutes is 6 minutes greater than a value of 12 minutes.

keyboard_touch.guard: Native dialog contains focus while open. Escape keeps editing; focus returns to trigger.
keyboard_touch.touch: Prototype buttons aim for 44–56px or larger control heights; these are proposed hit areas, not universal WCAG requirements. No drag-only or hover-only path.
keyboard_touch.special: Use explicit controls rather than gesture shortcuts.
keyboard_touch.reduced_motion: No animation or scroll reveals; pressed translation removed for reduced motion.

review_gates: Unavailable date clears only time; recovery preserves meeting/people/service.
Space change clears time; retains name/people and validates new capacity.
Review shows UTC, duration, all fixture fees and exact cancellation boundary before Confirm.
14:00 conflict → 15:00 review → explicit confirm exactly once; no automatic alternative booking.
Repeated confirm is disabled; changing input invalidates earlier confirmation.
No horizontal overflow at both recorded viewports; inspect first screen and important later stages.
Check enabled/disabled/hover/focus/selection states; status and selection must have written or native semantic signals.
Exercise repeated activation, interrupted navigation, Back, keyboard activation and explicit reset.
Reject external requests, unescaped input, fabricated loading, unexplained hero copy, hidden costs/conditions or false native-phone/screen-reader/usability claims.
protected_state: confirmation ID; at most one current confirmation
design_instructions: Build booking from the web-flows-oct4-v1 fixture. Render the booking/select entry and every main-path stage.
Show space/capacity/duration before availability, then only the fixture dates and time slots.
Keep date/time/timezone together and all costs/terms before the final action in DOM order.
On the prescribed stale-slot event, retain independent inputs; mark 14:00 unavailable. Require a new explicit confirmation after choosing 15:00.
No real availability check, account, network, payment or email. Say Confirmed locally and No booking sent or payment made.
Keep all actions local and synchronous; escape all user input in HTML output. Use semantic headings, labels, buttons and native controls.
Use this preset’s role names and exact proposed token values; do not substitute a shared dashboard skeleton or generic blue primary.
Render at 1165×747 and 390×844 CSS pixels. Preserve the first completed source before repairs; log each objective fix.

main_path: space/capacity: Small room or Quiet desk
date/time: select available slot; meeting name and people
review: exact date/time/timezone/space/cost/terms
14:00 Small room confirm → conflict → choose 15:00 → review again
explicit local confirm → DEMO-B01
state_conditions: Invalid name or people outside capacity
Small room 14:00 becomes unavailable at confirmation
Alternative 15:00 selected; explicit confirmation still required

navigation_requirements.back: Return to the preceding relevant stage with the applicable committed values, selections and records retained.
navigation_requirements.exit: Switching examples retains local state. Attempting to leave a changed work edit or unsaved community reply requires a decision to keep editing or discard unsaved changes.
navigation_requirements.cancel: Provide the stated change/back/recovery paths; do not invent an external cancellation action.
navigation_requirements.browser_back: Within the example, preserve applicable state and protect unsaved changes; repeated navigation must be safe.

protected_state: confirmation ID; at most one current confirmation

fixture.terms: Fictional policy: cancel by October 14, 14:00 UTC for no fee; after that, 50% of the session price. Prices include all fixture fees.

artifact_classification: Authored, guided preset demonstration. No unguided comparison arm, effectiveness experiment or measured improvement.
